stem: The random variable $X$ has mean 2.4 and variance 3.1.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: The random variable $Y$ is the sum of four independent values of $X$. Find the mean and variance of $Y$.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: The random variable $Z$ is defined by $Z = 4X - 3$. Find the mean and variance of $Z$.
